blocks.text: Canadian actor Simu Liu, who’s known for his work in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, has tied the knot with his non-showbiz fiancée, Allison Hsu. Celebrity news website TMZ said on Monday, Oct 5, that the couple tied the knot in France over the weekend. A publicist for Liu later confirmed it to CBC News. Liu, 37, and Hsu, 30, got married almost four years after they went Instagram official in November 2022 when Hsu shared a photo of herself with Liu, using a smiling emoticon as the caption.
